technical.summary: Bullish short-term momentum with Ichimoku cross-up and three white soldiers, but overbought conditions and weak long-term trend (below 200-SMA) limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 5 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buy signal from small-amount trades 97+ days old; greed sentiment (66) suggests caution; neutral AAII sentiment (51% bullish) and absent recent news provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 96 crisis regime) combined with critical earnings binary event in 5 days create compounded downside risk for MMM; unfavourable environment for directional positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: Ichimoku cloud cross-up with three white soldiers and CMF cross-up provide genuine short-term bullish momentum setup near support level (78.735).
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings event in 5 days combined with VIX crisis regime (96), inverted yield curve, overbought oscillators, price below 200-SMA/50-SMA, and zero fundamental/insider conviction create compounded downside binary risk that overwhelms technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows genuine Ichimoku cross-up with three white soldiers at support, but this is insufficient to justify entry given critical earnings binary in 5 days and VIX crisis regime (96).
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 5 days creates binary downside risk in unfavourable macro environment (inverted yield curve, VIX 96); overbought oscillators and price below 200-SMA suggest momentum exhaustion into event.
